sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression confirmed by anti-Flag flow cytometry on intact HEK293 cells; cytokine-receptor function of the WT tagged construct not explicitly assayed (used as reference backbone for variant studies).
sites.rationale: IL2RG is a Type I single-pass transmembrane protein: the ectodomain (residues 23–262) is N-terminal and extracellular, the C-terminus (residues 280–369) is intracellular. Because the Flag antibody detects the tag on the surface of intact cells, the 3×Flag must reside in the extracellular domain. There is exactly one extracellular terminus — the mature N-terminus beginning at residue 23 (after signal-peptide cleavage at residue 22) — so the tag is placed immediately after the signal peptide, between residue 22 (G) and residue 23 (L). Python confirmed residue 22 = G and residue 23 = L from the canonical sequence; the insert site is 240 residues from the TM boundary, well clear of the ≥3-residue constraint. pCMV-3×Flag-WT-IL2RG full-length construct transfected into HEK293 cells; surface expression of the Flag-tagged protein confirmed by anti-Flag antibody staining on intact (non-permeabilised) cells by flow cytometry (L2). No residue number is stated in either L1 or L2.

sources.claim: After 48 hours post-transfection, the surface expression of IL2RG (CD132) was assessed using a Flag tag antibody (Abways, AB0008, Shanghai, China) and Goat anti-Mouse IgG (H+L) Highly Cross-Adsorbed Secondary Antibody, Alexa Fluor™ 488 (Invitrogen, A-11029, Carlsbad, CA, USA).

literature_notes: Only two ledger lines are available (L1, L2), both from the same paper (PMC12423446). Neither names a specific residue or loop for the 3×Flag insertion. The position is topology-derived: IL2RG has a single extracellular terminus (the mature N-terminus after SP cleavage at residue 22), and surface detection by anti-Flag antibody on intact cells (L2) unambiguously places the tag there. The construct name 'pCMV-3×Flag-WT-IL2RG' (tag name preceding gene name) is consistent with N-terminal tagging convention, reinforcing the topology-derived assignment. No internal loop positions, no intracellular positions, and no function-abrogating positions are reported in the ledger.
